name: Nonaka Yoshiko
source:
A teacher at the cram school.

She lives in the same apartment as Yumi and her daughter and runs a cram school. She seems to be good at teaching. Even Junpei's grades seem to have increased enough for him to get a school award.

She has long hair tied up in a ribbon and Lolita-style clothing. She has big breasts and long hair, and has a calm and gentle personality. In a different way from Akira, she has a character of not being able to say no. She enjoys making sweets.

She is the envy of all the boys at the school, not to mention Akira, because of her big breasts, which Kazuko and Yuki do not have.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/bokumitsu.html]official site[/url]]
